title: Shadow Swap
summary: Experimental public-asset AMM pools, liquidity provision and NFT marketplace templates on Esmeralda testnet. Formerly Tari/Ootle Liquidity Protocol. On October 14, 2026, the creator documented migration to Ootle 0.46 / Protocol V2 and CLI-based on-chain settlements; live browser-wallet approval remains unproven in the creator’s record. Mainnet is disabled. The reviewed README names a Cloudflare hosting project but supplies no public demo URL. MIT is declared in package metadata, with a missing license-text file acknowledged by the creator.
creator: GSXRspartan
publicationBasis: Repository creation date reported by GitHub; not a verified first release or forum announcement date.
